October 26, 2026 
 
To, 
The Listing Department 
The National Stock Exchange of 
India Limited (“NSE”) 
Exchange Plaza, C-1, Block G Bandra-
Kurla Complex, Bandra (East) Mumbai 
– 400 051  
 
Symbol: RUNWALENTR 
The Department of Corporate Services 
BSE Limited (“BSE”) 
Phiroze Jeejeebhoy 
Towers, Dalal Street 
Mumbai – 400001 
 
 
Scrip Code: 544959 
 
 
 
Subject: Audio recording of Earnings Conference call on Unaudited (Standalone 
and Consolidated) Financial Results for first quarter ended June 30, 2026 under 
Regulation 30 and 46 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) 
Regulations, 2015 (“SEBI LODR”) 
Dear Sir/Madam, 
In furtherance to our Intimation Letter dated October 21, 2026 intimating schedule 
of Earnings Call and pursuant to Regulation 30 and 46 of SEBI LODR, the audio 
recording of today’s Earnings Conference Call i.e. of October 26, 2026 on Unaudited 
(Standalone and Consolidated) Financial Results for first quarter ended June 30, 
2026 of the Company is available in its website and can be accessed at 
https://runwalenterprises.com/investor-relations. 
We request you to kindly take the same on record. 
Thanking You, 
For and on behalf Runwal Enterprises Limited 
 
 
Abhishek Kumar Jain 
Company Secretary & Compliance officer 
 
ABHISHEK 
KUMAR 
JAIN
Digitally signed by 
ABHISHEK KUMAR 
JAIN 
Date: 2026.10.26
